text:
Keys and types

PK  primary key, unique row id
FK  points to another table's PK
UQ  no two rows share it
IX  indexed, a query is fast
NN  never empty

bigint     counting id, one DB hands it out
uuid       any device makes it, works offline
varchar    short text
text       long text
timestamp  store in UTC
jsonb      flexible extra fields
enum       a fixed set of values
